author: Tressk
quote: They should've called this game "Grand Simp Auto 6" because that's exactly what it is. You spend all game doing meaningless chores for your ungrateful latina GF, and you can't even do the thing the game was named after, that being, commit "Grand Theft Auto" until way later in the game. There's a clear political bias at play here in the development process for this game and it shows in the gameplay itself. You cannot shoot up protestors or clubs. They've even removed being able to hire prostitutes. You cannot even cheat on Lucia (your latina GF). It would've been interesting to have elements of cheating or hiring prostitutes (like you could in previous GTA games) and then just have your trust in Lucia drop and have actual consequences to cheating on her. This game reeks of lack of effort and it's a shame because with 13 years and 2 billion dollars worth of budget, you could have done so much more. Do not buy this game, there a literally thousands and thousands of much better games that are worth your time and money much more than this garbage.
